summary: Tennis tournament Tennis tournament 2022 ITF World Tennis Tour Gran Canaria Date 1–7 August 2022 Edition 2nd Category ITF Women's World Tennis Tour Prize money $60,000 Surface Clay / Outdoor Location San Bartolomé de Tirajana , Spain Champions Singles Arantxa Rus Doubles Jéssica Bouzas Maneiro / Leyre Romero Gormaz ← 2021 · ITF World Tennis Tour Gran Canaria · 2023 → The 2022 ITF World Tennis Tour Gran Canaria was a professional tennis tournament played on outdoor clay courts . It was the second edition of the tournament which was part of the 2022 ITF Women's World Tennis Tour . It took place in San Bartolomé de Tirajana , Spain between 1 and 7 August 2022.
